title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin holds at sixty-four thousand five hundred seventy dollars after a one point nine percent overnight gain, even with fear and greed locked at twenty-nine. Hashrate sits firm at seven hundred eighty-four exahashes, showing miners are not backing off.

Asia session buying lifted price through the low sixty-fours while volume stayed thin. Mempool carries eighty-six thousand transactions yet fees remain at one sat per vbyte, keeping the network light.
